subject: Shiny App: Connection attempt was aborted.

messages.author: e916d7bb0005907c
messages.subject: Shiny App: Connection attempt was aborted.
parts:
Hello,

I have just installed Shiny Server on a Ubuntu 12.04 32Bit system. When starting the service with "sudo start shiny-server" the server stats running and I can access the root directory with the web browser. But when selecting one of the example apps the app only says 
"An error has occurred 

The application failed to start.

Connection attempt was aborted."
This also happens with the ui/server example from the shiny tutorial.
The log file also doesn't contain any information.

Does anyone has an idea, what might be the problem?

Thorsten
